findings.issue: Tasks T3 (InsightCache), T4 (GraphRAG v2 prompts), T6 (InsightSession rewrite), T7 (WebViewBridge protocol), T8 (WorkspaceManager + ZIP export) lack Verify-smoke / Verify-user even though they touch external integration (Anthropic prompts, /usr/bin/zip Process spawn, postMessage protocol, disk cache atomic writes, iframe lifecycle).

findings.fix: Remove '~1 hour' or replace with non-time-bound mitigation language (e.g. 'small constrained rework — constrain WKWebViewConfiguration to disable bridge handlers in subframes').

findings.issue: Possible duplication between Decisions and task descriptions for specific values: 'capped at 5' appears in Decision 1 and Tasks 5/6; 'lazy load Mermaid' appears in Decision 5 caveats and Task 5; '/usr/bin/zip' specifics appear in Decision 7 and Task 8.
findings.fix: Keep concrete values/rationale in Decisions; in task descriptions, reference the decision number ('per Decision 1 — 5 concurrent cap') rather than repeating the value. Reduces drift if a decision changes.

summary: Tech-spec is structurally sound and approved for decomposition. All template sections present, frontmatter correct (size: L, branch: feature/recursive-insight-v2), 12 tasks within ≤15 limit, no wave conflicts (EditorView.swift modified by T7 in Wave 4 and T8 in Wave 5 — sequential, not parallel — OK), Audit Wave + Final Wave correctly structured (Deploy/Post-deploy absent for desktop app, as intended). All skills match catalog, all reviewers exist as agents. Minor findings are stylistic (task brevity in T5/T7, missing test-reviewer in T2, missing per-task smoke in T3/T4/T6/T7/T8, one residual time estimate '~1 hour' in Risks, duplication between Decisions and tasks). Zero critical findings; status = approved.
